decision_rule: Over the probe windows whose character-count labelling cleared its own shuffle draws, the largest gap between any two periods, in characters, must be at most 10. Larger rules out a single fixed period. Fewer than two windows clearing leaves the gap undefined.
metric: Largest gap in characters between the pattern periods of any two probe windows that both cleared.
notes: A period drifting by, say, 12 characters would be called not fixed here, even if it were one mechanism plus noise. The 10-character cutoff is the previous rung's own guess and is binding. This is one half of that rung's fork, which this design reuses and does not redefine. If the floor gate recorded in these values failed, this record is void as evidence about the model, and is an instrument fault only. A further run of this script on the same box is a rerun of the same instrument, not a replication.
